scripts.wdio:clean: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force allure-results, allure-report -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Cleaned allure-results and allure-report folders'
scripts.report:open: powershell -Command "$latest = Get-ChildItem -Path './allure-report' -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($latest) { npx allure open $latest.FullName } else { Write-Host 'No reports found' }"
